description: MacBook Pro (14-inch, M1 Pro, 2021) on the converged image, over SSH: raw host answers for record mode
source: Real run of omarchy-m-test 0.1.2 --dry-run --record on the M1 Pro, 2026-09-27 (Brisbane), over SSH with nobody at the Mac: the converged stack (omarchy 4.0.0 quattro, omarchy-mac 0.1.0, linux-aurora 7.1.12.aurora2-10, Limine, LUKS root) after the mx-mac migration. Every answer is what the Mac gave, except the camera, function-key and ports answers (checks added after this run): those are stand-ins, noted on each entry, until the next dogfood run records them.
pseudonymized: Committed evidence is pseudonymized: record mode saved it scrubbed, and every placeholder (<hostname>, <user>, <home>, <ssid>, <ip>, <mac>, <uuid>, <hex>, <disk>, <email>) was swapped back for a same-shape decoy, so rerunning record mode over it exercises the scrubber and gives the recording the Mac saved. The saved connections are a Wi-Fi decoy and NetworkManager's own for the tailscale0 tunnel, the docker0 bridge and lo, restored to their interface names (record mode used to scrub them as <ssid>). NetworkManager's <info> and dtc's <stdout> are their own. 'forbidden' lists the decoys and the lab hostname. The camera module's serial in the ISP's log lines is swapped for a fake of the same shape too.

swipe=$(hyprctl getoption gestures:workspace_swipe 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^int: *//p')
[ -n "$swipe" ] && echo "swipe-live $swipe"
field() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | sed -nE "s/.*$2=\"?([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\"?([,;}].*)?$/\1/p"; }
n=0
for f in "$HOME"/.local/share/omarchy/default/hypr/*.lua "$HOME"/.local/share/omarchy/default/hypr/*.conf \
         "$HOME"/.config/hypr/*.lua "$HOME"/.config/hypr/*.conf; do
  [ -r "$f" ] || continue
  n=$((n + 1))
  { sed -e 's/--.*$//' -e 's/#.*$//' "$f" | tr -d ' \t' | tr '\n' ';'; echo; } |
    sed -e 's/^/;/' -e 's/hl\./\nhl./g' -e 's/;gesture=/\ngesture=/g' -e 's/;workspace_swipe=/\nworkspace_swipe=/g' |
    while IFS= read -r c; do
      case $c in
        'hl.gesture({'*)
          c=${c%%\}*}
          [ "$(field "$c" fingers)" = 3 ] || continue
          action=$(printf '%s\n' "$c" | sed -nE 's/.*action="([a-z]+)"([,;].*)?$/\1/p')
          case $action in workspace|unset) ;; *) action=other;; esac
          echo "gesture 3 $(field "$c" direction) $action";;
        'gesture=3,'*)
          c=${c#gesture=}; c=${c%%;*}
          old=$IFS; IFS=,; set -- $c; IFS=$old
          dir=$2; shift 2; action=other
          for a in "$@"; do case $a in *:*) ;; workspace|unset) action=$a; break;; *) break;; esac; done
          echo "gesture 3 $dir $action";;
        'workspace_swipe='*)
          case ${c#workspace_swipe=} in true*|1*|yes*|on*) echo "workspace-swipe 1";; *) echo "workspace-swipe 0";; esac;;
      esac
    done
done
echo "files $n"

/usr/lib/omarchy-mac/battery-charge-limi.text:
#!/bin/bash
# udev runs this as the SMC battery appears, so a saved charge limit survives
# reboots. It never fails the event: anything unexpected leaves the SMC alone.
set -euo pipefail

saved_file="/etc/udev/macsmc-battery.conf"
end_file="/sys/class/power_supply/macsmc-battery/charge_control_end_threshold"

[[ $(omarchy-hw-platform 2>/dev/null) == "apple-silicon" ]] || exit 0
[[ -r $saved_file && -w $end_file ]] || exit 0

limit=""
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do
  if [[ $line == CHARGE_CONTROL_END_THRESHOLD=* ]]; then
    limit=${line#*=}
  fi
done <"$saved_file"

if [[ $limit == "80" || $limit == "100" ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$limit" >"$end_file" || true
fi
